autoban_hint: Members who post any of these words are banned immediately. Use with care.
filtered_hint: Messages containing these words are deleted when the word filter is enabled server-wide or in a channel.
invite_hint: Delete Discord invite links posted by members
invite_only_here: Enable the invite filter only in these channels.
invite_server_wide: The invite filter is on server-wide, so these channel entries have no extra effect.
link_hint: Delete any message containing a URL
link_only_here: Enable the link filter only in these channels.
link_server_wide: The link filter is on server-wide, so these channel entries have no extra effect.
page_subtitle: Block words, invites, and links before they reach your members
server_wide_hint: These apply in every channel. Use channel overrides to enable a filter only in specific places.
warnings_hint: Give the member a warning in addition to deleting the message. Warning punishments on the Moderation page still apply.
word_hint: Delete messages containing any filtered word
word_only_here: Enable the word filter only in these channels.
word_server_wide: The word filter is on server-wide, so these channel entries have no extra effect.
